analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI exiting oversold + MACD improvement confirmed
analysis.reason: 직전 매수 판단(10/06) 이후 3거래일 연속 상승 추세 진행 중. RSI 46.2→59.0으로 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램 1.1989→2.9793으로 개선되며 상승 모멘텀 강화. 5일 고가 $380.84, 20일 고가 $380.84로 새로운 고점 형성 가능성. 거래량 1.40배로 움직임 신뢰도 상승.
analysis.reasonEn: The uptrend has been progressing for 3 consecutive sessions since the last buy signal (10/06). RSI confirmed exit from oversold territory (46.2→59.0). MACD histogram improved (1.1989→2.9793), strengthening upward momentum. With the 5-day high at $380.84 and 20-day high at $380.84, potential for new high formation exists. Volume at 1.40x, increasing confidence in the move.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($375.81) vs SMA5 ($357.66) / SMA20 ($354.44) / SMA50 ($372.16): Above SMA5 and SMA20, near SMA50, confirming short-to-medium term bullish position.
· Position vs SMA100 ($384.89) / SMA200 ($366.64): Below SMA100, above SMA200, indicating short-term bullish dominance amidst mixed medium-to-long term trends.
· 52-week position (41.9%) + Current price level is significantly above historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (46.2→59.0) + Confirmed exit from oversold and entry into neutral zone + strengthening upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (1.1989→2.9793) + Improvement diagnosis + strengthening bullish trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-band $354.44) + Bandwidth at a normal level of 10.39%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($370.65) + Basis (Moving Average based).
· Swing Resistance ($376.59) + Potential for further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day / 20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low) + Confirmed recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.40x) + Increased confidence in the move.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Uptrend) + Buy entry upon confirmation of $370.65 support, expecting further upside on breaking $376.59 resistance.
